name: Stale ticket sweep
summary: Once a week the support lead gets one sheet of what the queue is hiding: tickets with no real activity past their limit, tickets left waiting on the customer with the three ways out of each, likely duplicates, and each person's load weighed by size and age. A person makes every move.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own method for a weekly sweep of a support queue from an export: set column headings with a stop on any mismatch, working days around closed days, reminder and closing rules for waiting tickets, a list of statuses the customer has overtaken, load as size points times an age factor, comparison with last week's sheet, and every open ticket counted once.

sources.contribution: A different inactivity limit for each kind of status, with default ranges and a shorter limit for unowned tickets; real activity as opposed to automatic updates, with status changes as a weaker fallback; three ways to resolve a ticket left with the customer; duplicate signals and linking in place of merging; load judged by more than a count; longest overdue first; and proposing without acting.
